message.content:
Below is a ready‑to‑run **gcloud** command that creates a new Compute Engine VM on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) with:

* **Machine type:** `n1-standard-8` (you can adjust the CPU/RAM count)
* **GPU:** 1 NVIDIA RTX A6000
* **Boot disk:** Ubuntu 20.04 LTS (focal)
* **Zone:** `us-central1-a` (change to your preferred zone)

```bash
# 1️⃣ Authenticate (if you haven’t already)
gcloud auth login

# 2️⃣ Set your project ID
PROJECT_ID="your-project-id"
ZONE="us-central1-a"

# 3️⃣ Create the instance
gcloud compute instances create my-rtx-a6000 \
    --project=${PROJECT_ID} \
    --zone=${ZONE} \
    --machine-type=n1-standard-8 \
    --boot-disk-size=200GB \
    --boot-disk-type=pd-balanced \
    --image-family=ubuntu-2004-lts \
    --image-project=ubuntu-os-cloud \
    --maintenance-policy=MIGRATE \
    --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform \
    --accelerator=count=1,type=nvidia-tesla-a6000 \
    --metadata-from-file startup-script=startup.sh \
    --tags=http-server,https-server
```

### What each flag does

| Flag | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `--project` | Your GCP project ID |
| `--zone` | Zone where the instance will live |
| `--machine-type` | Number of vCPU & RAM (`n1-standard-8` → 8 vCPU, 30 GB RAM) |
| `--boot-disk-size` | Size of the boot disk (adjust if you need more storage) |
| `--boot-disk-type` | Disk type (`pd-balanced` gives good performance at moderate cost) |
| `--image-family` / `--image-project` | Use the official Ubuntu 20.04 LTS image |
| `--accelerator` | Attach one RTX A6000 GPU |
| `--metadata-from-file startup-script=startup.sh` | Optional: run a shell script after boot (e.g., install drivers) |
| `--tags` | Network tags for firewall rules (allow HTTP/HTTPS) |

> **Tip:** If you prefer the REST API instead of the CLI, here’s the equivalent JSON payload you would POST to `https://compute.googleapis.com/compute/v1/projects/{PROJECT_ID}/zones/{ZONE}/instances`:

```json
{
  "name": "my-rtx-a6000",
  "machineType": "projects/{PROJECT_ID}/zones/us-central1-a/machineTypes/n1-standard-8",
  "disks": [
    {
      "boot": true,
      "autoDelete": true,
      "initializeParams": {
        "diskSizeGb": 200,
        "sourceImage": "projects/ubuntu-os-cloud/global/images/family/ubuntu-2004-lts"
      }
    }
  ],
  "networkInterfaces": [
    {
      "network": "global/networks/default",
      "accessConfigs": [{ "type": "ONE_TO_ONE_NAT", "name": "External NAT" }]
    }
  ],
  "scheduling": { "preemptible": false },
  "serviceAccounts": [
    {
      "email": "default",
      "scopes": ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    }
  ],
  "guestAccelerators": [
    {
      "acceleratorCount": 1,
      "acceleratorType": "projects/{PROJECT_ID}/zones/us-central1-a/types/nvidia-tesla-a6000"
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "items": [
      {
        "key": "startup-script",
        "value": "#!/bin/bash\nsudo apt-get update\nsudo apt-get install -y nvidia-driver-535"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

Replace `{PROJECT_ID}` and `us-central1-a` with your actual project ID and desired zone. Once you POST this JSON (using `curl` or Postman), the instance will spin up with the requested GPU and OS.
